A.text: Sir aapka bijli ka connection aaj raat kat jayega, bill update nahi hua hai. Abhi is number par call karein 97xxxx0831 aur officer ko batayein, warna meter hata diya jayega.
A.why: Threat (power cut tonight) + rush + an unknown number. Real electricity boards send bills, not midnight threats.

A.text: Hi, I accidentally sent Rs 12,000 to your number instead of my brother's. Please return it, I am sending you a request, just accept it to cancel. So sorry for the trouble.
A.why: The 'sent by mistake' trick: you never need to send money back to get money. A collect request takes money from you.

A.text: Bhai tere number pe galti se mera WhatsApp ka 6 digit code chala gaya hai, jaldi se bhej de na, mera account lock ho gaya hai. Please urgent hai.
A.why: A WhatsApp code is the key to your account. Nobody else ever needs it.

A.text: Dear customer, as per RBI guidelines your KYC re-verification is due. Please visit your home branch with Aadhaar and PAN before 31 Dec. No action is required on phone or link. -Union Bank of India
A.why: Asks you to visit your own branch. No link, no number to call, nothing to pay.

A.text: Flipkart: Aapka order (Redmi Note 14) aaj shaam tak deliver ho jayega. Delivery agent ko OTP 5532 dena. Order flipkart.com/orders par track karein.
A.why: A delivery OTP is meant for the agent at your door, for an order you placed.

A.text: Beta, mummy bol rahi hu. Is mahine ghar ka kharcha zyada ho gaya, ho sake to 5000 bhej dena. Aaram se, jab ho jaye tab. Khana time pe kha lena.
A.why: A known family member, no pressure, no link, no secrecy, and you can call back to check.

B.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9.30 PM as previous month bill is not updated. Contact electricity officer immediately on 97xxxx4412. Thank you.
B.why: Threat (power cut tonight) + rush + an unknown number. Real electricity boards send bills, not midnight threats.

B.text: Bhaiya galti se aapke number pe 5000 rupaye chale gaye, plz wapas kar do. Maine ek collect request bheji hai wo approve kar dena, paisa cancel ho jayega. Bahut meherbani.
B.why: The 'sent by mistake' trick: entering your UPI PIN on a collect request sends money out, it never brings it in.

B.text: Hey, I just got a WhatsApp code by mistake on your number, can you please forward me the 6-digit code? It's urgent, I'm locked out of my account. Thanks a lot!
B.why: A WhatsApp code is the key to your account. Nobody else ever needs it.

B.text: Sir, aapka KYC update pending hai. Kripya kisi bhi link par click na karein. Apne nazdiki Bank of Baroda branch me Aadhaar aur PAN ke saath 30 Nov tak aayein. - BOB
B.why: Tells you not to click links and to visit the branch. That is how real banks talk.

B.text: Your Uber ride with Suresh (KA05 AB 1234, white Swift) is arriving in 3 mins. Share OTP 4471 with the driver to start the trip.
B.why: A ride OTP is shown to the driver you booked, inside the app.

B.text: Papa ne bola hai UPI se 2000 bhej dena mama ko, unka gas ka bill dena hai. Bhej ke screenshot dikha dena. Thanks
B.why: A family errand you can confirm with your own father. No stranger, no rush, no link.
